scenarioText: You are a field engineer repairing a faulty solar array. Choose actions to restore power safely.

decisions.text: The inverter reports an over-voltage fault. What is the first action?

options.text: Isolate the array with the DC isolator
Touch the wiring to check heat

decisions.text: The array is isolated. What do you measure next?

options.text: Close everything and call it a day

decisions.text: String 3 reads near zero. What is the diagnosis?

options.text: A bypass diode is shorted in String 3
